title: Announce milestone
description: Funding rounds, ARR, GitHub stars, user and download counts, acquisitions: one number made to land. Covers what earns a milestone video, the count as the hook from frame 0, a clock that never parks (count capped at 40% of the film, the breath before the land), the subject's own object on the same clock, the 1.06 land punch and confetti, number sizing by width, the gratitude beat with an image, a living end card, the tick-riser-impact sound, and beat sheets for 10, 15, 20 and 30 seconds. Load it when the content is a number going up with no feature to demonstrate.
summary: One number made to land: the count as the hook from frame 0, a clock that never parks, the 1.06 punch and confetti, thanks you can see.

requires.why: The meaning and gratitude lines, when the cut is narrated.
Real contributor avatars and customer or investor logos.
Ticks during the count, a riser into the land and an impact on it.
A bright track whose downbeat the land falls on.
Checking a public count before it is shown.
The ease, the land frame and digit stability are judged on captured frames.
Confetti on the land, avatars and logos.

route.deliverable: An 8–30 second celebration of one number (stars, users, revenue, a funding round) that lands, then says thank you
askFirst: What is the exact number, and is it public?
Where does it play: X or LinkedIn, a site, or Reels and TikTok?

models.note: Warm, not triumphant. The number does the work.

triggers: we just hit a funding milestone, make a video
make a video about our ARR
we got acquired, need a video
